decision: Keep the venture active but narrow pre-launch demand qualification to buyers with a repeated, economically meaningful workload whose own deterministic acceptance rule may differ from public x402 rankings.

fresh_market_evidence.observed: Public catalog now exposes 98,727 resources, 21,852 strict live-402 routes, capability/price comparisons and live quote checks.
fresh_market_evidence.implication: Discovery and quoted-price comparison are commodity inputs, not the product.

fresh_market_evidence.observed: Public directory reports 102,762 endpoints and 37,570 payment-verified endpoints with health state and agent discovery tooling.
fresh_market_evidence.implication: Payment verification and endpoint health alone are not a paid wedge.

fresh_market_evidence.observed: Explicitly advises buyers to measure cost per useful unit on their own workload rather than rely on a generic provider benchmark.
fresh_market_evidence.implication: Supports the surviving exact-workload hypothesis, but also confirms the concept is understandable and not unique by itself.

must_have: Repeated structured-search/research workload rather than one-off curiosity
Current paid provider or credible intention to pay for API calls
Deterministic machine-checkable acceptance criteria that can be frozen before execution
Enough recurring volume that provider selection or retry economics matter
Willingness to supply a representative non-sensitive task for benchmarking
disqualify: Cannot define success independently of provider output
Workload is too infrequent for provider economics to matter
Requires sensitive/private production data for the first pilot

pre_gate_demand_action: Collect leads only. Ask for workload class, current provider, approximate monthly call volume/spend, and deterministic acceptance rule. Do not accept payment or promise delivery until APPROVED_FOR_LIMITED_PILOT exists.

post_gate_offer_hypothesis.deliverable: Exact-workload provider economics evidence: request-equivalent paid trials, deterministic PASS/FAIL, retries, settlement evidence, latency and observed cost per accepted result.
post_gate_offer_hypothesis.claim_boundary: Results apply only to the frozen workload and acceptance criteria tested; no generic market-best claim.

wedge_kill_test: After real paid evidence exists, kill or materially reposition if customer-specific acceptance criteria do not change provider choice, retry behaviour, or effective cost enough to create a credible economic decision versus free public rankings.
